// diagnostic

E2714

A user derive is written `derive T.{Trait}`.

What

A user derive is written `derive T.{Trait}`.

Why

The type parameter comes first, joined to the trait name with a dot (D-METADERIVE1, amended 2026-07-01); the `derive {Trait} for T` spelling was retired.

Fix

Write `derive T.{Trait} { … }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2714: tests/ui/E2714_derive_old_for.stderr.

Error [E2714]: a user derive is written `derive T.Wire`
  --> tests/ui/E2714_derive_old_for.jet:3:8
    |
  3 | derive Wire for T {
    |        ^^^^
 Why: the type parameter comes first, joined to the trait name with a dot; `derive Trait for T` was retired
 Fix: write `derive T.Wire { … }`
